propositions: DC transport raises JIRAError which does not match urllib.error.HTTPError caught by core reconciler modules, causing exceptions to escape instead of degrading gracefully
outbound_differ._safe_get_issue cannot classify remotely-deleted DC issues as _DELETED because JIRAError does not match the 404 detection logic
dispatch_apply_phases catches only urllib.error.HTTPError so a DC 4xx (Modify-Reporter denied) escapes instead of recording outbound-reporter-not-permitted
BackendHTTPError declared as port exception contract, subclassing urllib.error.HTTPError with .code attribute, eliminates vendor-specific exception types from core modules
DC transport translates JIRAError to BackendHTTPError at adapter boundary preserving HTTP status code, making it catchable by existing core exception handlers without code edits
